title: Identify Like Terms
text:
Like terms have the same variable raised to the same power.

In $2x^2 - 10x + 3x - 15$:
- $2x^2$ is the only $x^2$ term
- $-10x$ and $+3x$ are like terms (both are $x$ terms)
- $-15$ is a constant term

title: Combine the x Terms
text:
Add the coefficients of the like terms:

$-10x + 3x = (-10 + 3)x = -7x$

Be careful with signs when combining!

title: Final Answer
text:
Putting it all together:

$2x^2 - 10x + 3x - 15 = 2x^2 - 7x - 15$

The expression is now fully simplified in standard form (descending powers of $x$).
